name: navig-cabinet
summary: NAVIG Cabinet — your documents in one plugin: an encrypted cabinet for important files (ID and passport scans, medical records, contracts, photos, recordings — any type, any size; local-OCR search, expiry reminders, portable backups) plus `navig paperwork`, which files business paperwork (invoices, quotes, contracts, tax) into a space. A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).
